public.auth:validateSignupData: Sign-up form: checks the CFA number and email are free before an account exists.
public.availability:getMainStatusOptions: Static list of status labels; no data.
public.availability:getAvailableStatusOptions: Static list of status labels; no data.
public.passwordReset:requestPasswordReset: Forgot-password form; same answer whether or not the email exists, throttled per address.
public.passwordReset:verifyResetToken: Reset link page; needs the emailed token.
public.passwordReset:resetPasswordWithToken: Reset link page; needs the emailed token.
public.serviceAccounts:validateServicePin: Kiosk PIN sign-in; rate-limited per device and brigade-wide.
public.serviceAccounts:getServiceSession: Kiosk checks its own session token.
public.serviceAccounts:logoutServiceAccount: Kiosk ends its own session token.

self.auth:loggedInUser: The caller's own account row; the app needs it to show the pending and disabled screens.
self.auth:storeSignupData: The caller's own pending sign-up only.
self.auth:changePassword: The caller's own password; needs the current one.
self.modules:getAllModuleAccess: The caller's own access map; false everywhere for pending and disabled accounts.
self.userLaunches:recordLaunch: Records the caller's own app launch.
